summary.text: David Penaloza is a Democratic member of the Santa Ana City Council running for California State Assembly District 68 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces fellow Democrat Jessie Lopez.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a regulatory manager at Color Science, Inc. and the council's mayor pro tem.

paragraphs.text: David Penaloza earned a high school diploma from Saddleback High School and a bachelor's degree from California State University, Los Angeles, in 2011.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in Santa Ana's Memorial Park neighborhood by Mexican immigrant parents and has a bachelor's degree in English.
He said he built a career at Color Science, Inc., where he is senior regulatory manager.
Penaloza has served on the Santa Ana City Council since 2019, currently representing Ward 6, and he is not seeking re-election to it in 2026.
He said in the survey that he first ran in 2018, was elected to represent Ward 2, moved to Ward 6 after redistricting, was re-elected in 2022 and serves as mayor pro tem.
He also said he chairs the Toll Roads and was elected president of the Orange County Division of the League of California Cities in 2025.
Among his key messages, Penaloza cited the rising cost of living and said he would work to increase housing supply and homeownership opportunities and reduce wasteful government spending.
